name: Per-search optional-organ readiness snapshot
stockfish_assumption: Runtime subsystem readiness may need to be queried wherever the subsystem could be used.
reason_for_assumption: Subsystems are optional and configured dynamically through UCI state.
removed_assumption: UCI options and model/file configuration are immutable for the duration of one go, so each worker can snapshot a readiness bitmask once.
local_exactness: Normalized scores, nodes, PVs, and best moves matched at 3210480, 1286415, and 2451202 nodes.

local_timing_screen.classification: Invalid for magnitude because A/A failed; sufficient only to justify replication.

remote_test: 21 drift-sandwiched rounds versus the exact cumulative source commit, with an identical-binary A/A channel and three transcript gates.
promotion_rule: No promotion from this run alone. Require A/A pass, positive bootstrap interval, a second independent run, and a game-position timing panel.
